To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fatty acids recovered from triglycerides and those from wax esters of the same copepods are very similar, and that the fatty acids of triglycerides and of the wax ester fraction of fish oils are also similar, suggesting that the fatty acids from the copepods are a major source of fatty acids in fish oils.

the fatty acid compositions of the wax ester and triglyceride lipids of the same copepod species are similar to one another and that the wax ester fatty acid composition of copepods is quite similar to that of the wax estering fish oils and lipids.
the fatty acids of fish depot fats are largely derived from the dietary wax ester lipids of their copepod prey.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fatty acids recovered intact from fish oils and from certain fish lipids.
the role of copepids in supplying the basic fatty acids to fish lipids, and in particular with the role of the copepod wax-ester fatty acids in the formation of fish wax esters.
the lipid composition of marine copepods and their possible role in the nutrition of marine fish.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the copepods are the source of all the fatty acids found in the wax esters and triglycerides of these fish.
the fatty acids of all types of fish lipids are a reflection of the dietary fatty acids, and the fish lipids are not a primary source of the fatty acids in fish depot fats.

the fatty acids in the wax esters of fish oils, as recovered from the oils, are identical in composition to those in the wax ester fraction of the same oils, and are identical to those of the copepods which are the major source of fish oils.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fatty acids of fish depot lipids are largely derived from the wax ester lipids of copepods.
the fatty acid composition of the wax ester fraction is the same in copepods as in fish oils.

wax esters are a very important source of polyunsaturates for fish, and that the fish triglycerides contain the fatty acids of both wax esters and triglycerides, but that the triglyceride fatty acids are the more important source of the saturated fatty acids.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fish lipids are a good source of fatty acids that are important to human health.

the fatty acids of copepod wax esters are a good model for the fatty acids of fish depot fat and oils, and that the fatty acid composition of the fish depot fat and oil is a reflection of the dietary fatty acids.
the fatty acid compositions of the fish oils and the wax esters of fish muscle are very similar to the wax ester fatty acid compositions of copepods.
